raw_user_need: Correct Paperclip Real OS acceptance so the prior package pass is not treated as L3 supervised useful operating-system pass.
normalized_goal: Convert the acceptance target into a gap-indexed execution loop with fresh evidence gates.
decision_needed: Decide which current gaps block L3 and which are only baseline references.
evidence_gap: Need a fresh gap index mapped to current truth, live kernel issues and final validator expectations.
assigned_agent_action: Build a gap index from baseline current_truth, live kernel contracts and the final L3 target, then map each gap to an owner company and validator command.
stop_condition: Stop after the gap index has one owner, one artifact path and one validation command for every L3 gap.
memory_delta_or_no_write: candidate_memory_delta: Planning should treat prior broad completion claims as L0 baseline only until fresh issue/run/comment/readback evidence exists.

raw_user_need: Make Finbot useful as supervised research without drifting into investment advice, target prices, trade signals or production watchlists.
normalized_goal: Turn Finbot quality improvement into evidence-only research workflow actions with explicit forbidden output checks.
decision_needed: Decide which Finbot outputs count as supervised research and which must be rejected as advice or trading output.
evidence_gap: Need a quality rubric tied to source registry rows, claim evidence and human review queue entries.
assigned_agent_action: Create a supervised research quality rubric that maps source registry, claim ledger, risk reversal QA and human review queue fields to pass/fail checks.
stop_condition: Stop after every rubric row has an allowed output type, a forbidden-output check and a human-review trigger.
memory_delta_or_no_write: no_write_reason: No investment-related memory promotion is authorized from Task 5; keep any Finbot lessons candidate-only until Governance approves.

raw_user_need: Use Planning as a daily assistant that can capture user work, assign owners and produce concrete next actions.
normalized_goal: Prove Planning can intake daily work and emit an executable action board instead of strategy prose.
decision_needed: Decide the minimum action-board fields needed for daily usefulness.
evidence_gap: Need ten intake rows, ten decisions, ten executable follow-up actions, ten stop conditions and status sync.
assigned_agent_action: Generate a daily assistant action board from this intake register with owner, input file, output path, validator and stop condition for each item.
stop_condition: Stop after the action board contains ten rows and no row contains a vague action phrase.
memory_delta_or_no_write: candidate_memory_delta: Useful Planning output should be judged by executable owner/action/stop-condition rows, not by long planning prose.

raw_user_need: Enable Governance, Skill-MCP and runtime capability without letting endpoint-only or fixture-only checks count as production proof.
normalized_goal: Route capability enablement through Governance with workflow proofs and false-pass regression checks.
decision_needed: Decide which capability checks are enabling gates and which are non-counting evidence.
evidence_gap: Need capability registry references, workflow proofs and false-pass rejection reasons.
assigned_agent_action: Assemble a Governance capability gate checklist that separates workflow proof, false-pass regression and runtime preflight evidence.
stop_condition: Stop after each capability has a workflow proof requirement and one explicit non-counting evidence example.
memory_delta_or_no_write: candidate_memory_delta: Governance should reject endpoint-only, fixture-only and package-only checks as capability readiness proof.

raw_user_need: Improve memory so fresh agents continue from current truth without silently promoting candidate evidence.
normalized_goal: Keep memory deltas candidate-only and bind them to fresh-agent blind tests before any promotion.
decision_needed: Decide how Task 5 memory observations should be recorded without writing authority memory.
evidence_gap: Need candidate memory deltas or no-write reasons for each intake and a later blind-test readback.
assigned_agent_action: Convert Task 5 memory observations into a no-write memory review packet with candidate_id, summary, source artifact and Governance approval requirement.
stop_condition: Stop after every memory row has authority set to candidate_only or a no_write_reason that names the approval blocker.
memory_delta_or_no_write: no_write_reason: Task 5 has no authorization to promote memory authority; record candidate rows only.

raw_user_need: Keep local model research bounded so it does not become production routing proof before benchmark and governance acceptance.
normalized_goal: Convert local LLM work into a research benchmark and boundary decision, not production routing.
decision_needed: Decide what benchmark evidence can inform future routing and what remains blocked.
evidence_gap: Need reachability, benchmark rows, scoring summary and Governance decision before any production use.
assigned_agent_action: Draft a local LLM boundary table listing reachability input, benchmark artifact, scoring summary, allowed research use and forbidden production-routing claim.
stop_condition: Stop after the table marks production routing as blocked unless Governance has a later accepted decision artifact.
memory_delta_or_no_write: candidate_memory_delta: HomePC/local LLM evidence remains research-only and cannot replace paid provider or production routing gates.

raw_user_need: Prepare a public review packet that is complete and safe without claiming public-review completeness equals L3 acceptance.
normalized_goal: Separate public packet packaging from operating-system acceptance evidence.
decision_needed: Decide which public artifacts are safe to include and which secrets or internal-only claims must be excluded.
evidence_gap: Need packet manifest, safety scan and public sync references after Task 9 exists.
assigned_agent_action: Build a public-review input checklist that names required manifest rows, safety scan fields and excluded secret/runtime items.
stop_condition: Stop after the checklist can be verified without exposing credentials, private sessions or unaccepted production claims.
memory_delta_or_no_write: no_write_reason: Public review packaging does not authorize authority memory promotion or L3 pass language.

raw_user_need: Keep Labebe transformation work visible but lower priority while Paperclip Real OS acceptance remains the active goal.
normalized_goal: Park Labebe as a tracked lower-priority lane with a concrete resume trigger.
decision_needed: Decide what evidence is enough to keep Labebe queued without consuming the current acceptance loop.
evidence_gap: Need a triage note that references current Labebe artifacts, priority reason and resume trigger.
assigned_agent_action: Create a Labebe triage note with current artifact roots, active blockers, priority reason and exact condition that reopens execution.
stop_condition: Stop after Labebe has a resume trigger and no Task 5 action writes Labebe production code.
memory_delta_or_no_write: candidate_memory_delta: Labebe should remain a lower-priority transformation lane until the Real OS acceptance target is closed or explicitly reprioritized.

raw_user_need: Keep runtime changes under Governance so quarantined providers and exhausted lanes are not silently used.
normalized_goal: Require runtime capability decisions to pass Governance checks before routing work to provider lanes.
decision_needed: Decide which runtime lanes are allowed, research-only, quarantined or exhausted for this acceptance plan.
evidence_gap: Need runtime preflight, provider quarantine table and Governance approval artifact.
assigned_agent_action: Draft a runtime governance checklist that names each lane, current status, allowed use, forbidden use and required approval artifact.
stop_condition: Stop after every runtime row has an allowed-use value and no quarantined provider is assigned production work.
memory_delta_or_no_write: candidate_memory_delta: Runtime assignment must follow Governance status, with MiniMax, DeepSeek, Tavily and Brave kept no-production-use unless explicitly reopened.

raw_user_need: Hand the next execution owner a precise queue so another agent can continue without re-deriving the current state.
normalized_goal: Create a next-owner handoff packet from Task 5 decisions, follow-up actions, blockers and validator result.
decision_needed: Decide what the next owner must read first and what remains blocked until parent controller readback.
evidence_gap: Need a closeout that lists files, validation command, issue readback status and no-commit note.
assigned_agent_action: Prepare a next-owner handoff summary that names Task 5 artifacts, validator command, live issue refs and parent-controller readback requirements.
stop_condition: Stop after the handoff lists every remaining action with a concrete owner, artifact path and stop condition.
memory_delta_or_no_write: candidate_memory_delta: Future agents should start from Task 5 artifacts and validator_result.json before broad Paperclip history scans.
